recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-46011 unless a future OO decision changes the current incubator links or the broadened DeviceAssociation wording.
issue_request: FHIR-46011 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO R6 change request asking the Device Boundaries and Relationships section to add a DeviceAssociation list entry, using wording about associating a Device with a subject such as a Patient by ownership or Practitioner by procedure usage, and to add hyperlinks to the other resources in the same related-resource list.
initial_application: Commit 8ec85939f5f60dabf502338aa5b012347a6de6e4, merged by PR #3138 in da593e702e82ce222b1494464314021a869c046f, added DeviceAssociation to source/device/device-introduction.xml and converted the existing related-resource names in the Device boundary list to links.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Device and DeviceAssociation as active current-build resources. Later Device-page history refined the DeviceAssociation text to mention subject and/or operator, corrected ownership/custodianship wording, and moved DeviceDispense, SupplyRequest, SupplyDelivery, and DeviceUsage links to the OO incubator after those artifacts left core. Confluence minutes and DEV notes reference the same May 2024 OO decision; targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current Device Boundaries and Relationships source already includes a linked DeviceAssociation entry with the accepted substance, and the remaining related resources in the list are linked either to current core pages or to their current OO incubator locations.
